payload.core_mechanism_summary: If suffix from index k-1 not uniform, print -1. Else, find the last index i < k-1 where a[i] != a[k-1]; answer is 0 if none, else i+1.
payload.rationale: Linear-time single pass with conditionals, no search or enumeration. Clearly not backtracking, bitmask, branch & bound, DFS/BFS, or permutation enumeration. Family mismatch due to non-search nature.
